name: hdl-h5-sv-uvm-v1
note: HDL track H5 (docs/HDL_DATA.md): SystemVerilog and UVM continued pretraining after H3. Open-source verification code from three pinned repositories (OpenTitan and Ibex, Apache-2.0; core-v-verif, Solderpad Hardware Licence 2.0, which lets the user take it as Apache-2.0), vendored third-party directories excluded; the-stack SystemVerilog once its terms are accepted and rows are filtered by repository licence; Verilog and English + maths replay against forgetting. The fetcher reads each repository's LICENSE file at the pinned commit.

sources.name: opentitan-sv
sources.license_note: Top-level LICENSE Apache-2.0; hw/vendor (third-party) excluded. About 38 MB of SystemVerilog, 12 MB of it UVM testbenches (hw/ip/*/dv, hw/dv).

sources.name: ibex-sv
sources.license_note: Top-level LICENSE Apache-2.0; vendor/ excluded. About 1.7 MB of SystemVerilog including the dv/uvm testbench.

sources.name: core-v-verif-sv
sources.license_note: LICENSE.md is the Solderpad Hardware Licence 2.0, a wraparound that lets the user treat the work as Apache-2.0. vendor/ and vendor_lib/ excluded. About 4.3 MB of SystemVerilog, mostly UVM.

sources.name: stack-systemverilog
sources.license_note: The Stack terms of use must be accepted on the Hub by the account first; then keep only rows whose max_stars_repo_licenses are all in the allow list.
